verdict.rationale: Fly.io ships an official, documented CLI, flyctl, used for launching apps (`fly launch`), running diagnostics (`fly doctor`), scaling (`fly scale`) and starting Machines (`fly machine run`). It also has an experimental `flyctl mcp` server mode that exposes the CLI to AI agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's use in agent workflows, and documentation of agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive modes (the MCP mode is only experimental).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
The `fly machine run` command is a tool to configure, build, and start a new Machine in one line.
